## What this changes

Describe the change in two or three sentences. Link the issue, for example "Part of #12".

## How it is tested

Name the tests that you added or changed. For a fix of a wrong answer, include the query that showed it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo xtask layers`, `cargo xtask style` and `cargo clippy` pass.
- [ ] The spec agrees with the change, or this pull request changes the spec.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" if a user can see the change.
- [ ] A performance claim has the machine, the baseline, the transport and the numbers.
- [ ] No code under the AGPL, the GPL or another copyleft license was read or copied.
